control_failures.control_label: mechanical support of a load during maintenance access

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: preventive action - alarm rationalisation on PR-9410

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on PR-9410 and M-9410 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining lifting appliances, specifically proof testing and periodic inspection of hoists. PR-9410 (workshop hoists and press) is in service for heavy vehicle component removal and pressing. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access had been bypassed. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 28 February 2019 a corrective action on PR-9410 and M-9410 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop was reviewed against the critical control it was raised to restore.
